apps.name: bsvOS Launcher
apps.blurb: The system app list: installed apps, the catalog, and one-click open. Ships with the daemon at https://127.0.0.1:2121/launcher/ and owns the 127.0.0.1 slot, so it never collides with the bundled feature apps on localhost.

apps.name: Pocket Pets
apps.blurb: Gacha buddies on BSV: raise pets, mint 1Sat NFT ordinals, battle, trade on the market. Runs on OS custody via window.bsv (needs entangleit.com/manifest.json).

apps.name: Twetch
apps.blurb: Feed and notifications companion: read the public Twetch feed, post text on-chain through the OS wallet (network fee only). Bundled with the daemon at https://localhost:2121/twetch/. Note: Cast, Twetch, Explorer and Colosseum all share this one localhost slot — install the one you want and open it from the Launcher.

apps.name: Atomic Market
apps.blurb: BRC-100 atomic-swap market: browse listings, buy ordinals and BSV21 tokens (payment + asset in one tx), list your own. Installs with window.bsv under this origin's policy.
